steps.say: ﻿Remind me to pay‌ the gym tomorrow at 9

note: BOM, zero-width non-joiner and control characters (BEL, ESC) are cleaned: normal commitment, clean title.
A message of only zero-width characters is empty after cleaning: no reply. Said at 00:05, tomorrow is Friday.
'do' followed by a pronoun is a question even without '?': not_commitment.
'move it to 5' is an edit: not_commitment, and the existing commitment's time is not changed.
Spanish question (¿cuándo ...?) is not a commitment; reply in Spanish.
Emoji only: ask_what with no wait; emoji plus a time: ask_what keeping the time; then the task fills it.
21 messages in the same minute: the first 20 are handled, the 21st (more than 20 in 60 s) gets rate_limited and is not read.
20 messages, then two minutes later a commitment: the window has passed, so it is read normally.
